.archivara/.purpose: Core research infrastructure scripts and configuration

files.concept_evolve.py: ConceptEvolve CLI - launches OpenCode sub-agents for concept-tree generation (evolve/probe/reframe/walk commands). Writes to results/concept_evolve/. Uses file locking and caching (2h TTL).
files.semantic_scholar.py: Semantic Scholar API client - search, citations, references, recommend, graph, bibtex commands. Writes JSON output, supports --save flag.
files.opencode.json: OpenCode configuration - defines model (claude-opus-4-6), agents, tool bindings, and permissions.
files.logs/: Runtime log directory for agent operations.

.opencode/.purpose: OpenCode plugin configuration, agent definitions, and tool wrappers

files.agents/concept-tree-explorer.md: Subagent definition for concept tree traversal - read-only tools (websearch, webfetch, todoread/write). Focuses on missing links and next experiments.
files.agents/literature-graph-miner.md: Subagent definition for citation graph mining - read-only tools. Prioritizes cross-domain citation chains.
files.tools/concept_evolve.ts: TypeScript tool wrapper for concept_evolve.py - exposes evolve/probe/reframe/walk to OpenCode agents. 20min timeout.
files.tools/semantic_scholar.ts: TypeScript tool wrapper for semantic_scholar.py - exposes search/citations/references/recommend/graph/bibtex to OpenCode agents.
files.package.json: Node.js package for OpenCode tool plugins.

results/.purpose: Output directory for all research artifacts, experiment data, and concept evolution results

subdirectories.concept_evolve/: ConceptEvolve outputs: concept_cards.json, semantic_bridge.json, introspection.json, steering_directions.json, evolve_results.json, summary.txt
subdirectories.concept_evolve/tree/: Concept tree: index.json, adjacency.json, walk_paths.json, and NNN_slug/ folders with concept.json + README.md
subdirectories.benchmarks/: Benchmark data and parser metrics (to be created)
subdirectories.literature_graph.json: Citation graph output from semantic_scholar.py graph command

src/.purpose: Source code for parser implementations (to be created)

planned_subdirectories.simd/: SIMD structural character classification (x86-64 AVX2, ARM64 NEON)

tests/.purpose: RFC 4180 compliance test suite (to be created)

orchestrator.description: Planning-only rubric author. Creates research_rubric.json. Cannot use concept_evolve tool.

researcher.description: Execution-heavy research worker. Implements experiments, runs benchmarks, writes code.

writer.description: Paper writing and synthesis worker. Produces report.md and documentation.

reviewer.description: Peer review and quality control worker. Validates claims and methodology.

concept_worker.description: ConceptEvolve sub-worker spawned by concept_evolve.py. No recursive concept tool.

concept_evolve_flow.input: User topic string via CLI or tool wrapper
concept_evolve_flow.processing: concept_evolve.py spawns OpenCode sub-agent via 'opencode run --agent build'. Sub-agent uses websearch, semantic_scholar, and write tools to produce artifacts.
concept_evolve_flow.output: JSON files in results/concept_evolve/ and concept folders in results/concept_evolve/tree/NNN_slug/
concept_evolve_flow.post_processing: concept_evolve.py builds adjacency graph, walk paths, and index from sub-agent artifacts

semantic_scholar_flow.input: Query string or paper ID via CLI or tool wrapper
semantic_scholar_flow.processing: semantic_scholar.py calls Semantic Scholar API with retry/backoff
semantic_scholar_flow.output: JSON to stdout (or --save path), BibTeX to stdout (>> sources.bib)

research_pipeline.rubric: research_rubric.json defines phases and items with status tracking
research_pipeline.artifact_accumulation: results/ grows through phases; figures/ populated in Phase 4-5

key_files.research_rubric.json: Master rubric with 27 items across 5 phases. Status tracking for frontend display.
key_files.sources.bib: BibTeX bibliography (to be created). Accumulates references throughout research.
key_files.TASK_researcher_attempt_1.md: Full task specification for researcher agent.
